messages.subject: diagnose writing out samples.csv?
parts:
1. I don't see the point of diagnose writing out a samples.csv
file. I could imagine it being useful if we had the output
of diagnose in there, but as is, it's just the same dump of
system config that gets printed out.

Am I missing something? Or should we just get rid of the
write for samples.csv from diagnose? (I only realized it
on a git status when I was playing around with some models
where I'd otherwise configured the output files.)

2. Alternatively, I could see having a "/dev/null" value for
output file, so I could at least turn off output for diagnose.

- Bob
